caption: The drawing depicts a kneeling angel with folded hands, shown as a figurine. The angel has light gray skin and wavy dark brown hair that falls to the shoulders. The eyes, nose, and mouth are delicately outlined. The angel wears a sleeveless, floor-length gown in shades of golden yellow with darker shading to indicate folds and contours. A white cord tied at the waist hangs down the front, ending in two black-tipped tassels. The angel's wings are depicted with a white base color and are decorated with patches and streaks of red, green, and black. The figure stands on a rectangular grayish pedestal. The drawing is executed on a beige paper with a faint pencil border framing the image, and the artist’s signature “Mima Lowry” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Angel Figure
